title: ARSIA JWT Access Token Claims
description: Schema for decoded ARSIA access token JWT claims per ARSIA-Core.md §6.1, and the OAuth 2.0 token response envelope per §6.2.

iss.description: Identifier of the Authorization Server that issued the token. ARSIA-Core.md §6.1.

sub.description: Agent identifier of the requesting agent. MUST match the 'from' field of any message presented with this token. ARSIA-Core.md §6.1.

aud.description: Agent identifier of the target agent. MUST match the 'to' field of any message presented with this token. ARSIA-Core.md §6.1.

exp.description: Expiration time as NumericDate per RFC 7519 §2. Token lifetime SHOULD be max 3600s; for high-risk profiles, max 300s is RECOMMENDED. ARSIA-Core.md §6.1.

iat.description: Issued-at time as NumericDate per RFC 7519 §2. ARSIA-Core.md §6.1.

scope.description: Space-separated list of capability identifiers. MUST cover all capabilities listed in the 'capabilities' field of any message presented with this token. ARSIA-Core.md §6.1.

cnf.description: Confirmation claim for proof-of-possession per RFC 9449. Contains the JWK Thumbprint of the DPoP key. ARSIA-Core.md §6.1, §6.3.

jkt.description: JWK Thumbprint (base64url) of the agent's DPoP key per RFC 9449.

token-request.title: ARSIA Token Request
token-request.description: OAuth 2.0 client credentials token request parameters per ARSIA-Core.md §6.2.

client_id.description: The requesting agent's identifier (URL-encoded agent-id). ARSIA-Core.md §6.2.

scope.description: Space-separated list of requested capabilities. ARSIA-Core.md §6.2.

audience.description: The target agent's identifier (URL-encoded agent-id). ARSIA-Core.md §6.2.

token-response.title: ARSIA Token Response
token-response.description: OAuth 2.0 token response envelope per ARSIA-Core.md §6.2.

token_type.description: Token type. MUST be 'Bearer' or 'DPoP'. ARSIA-Core.md §6.2.

scope.description: The granted scope (may differ from requested scope). ARSIA-Core.md §6.2.

verify-token-request.title: ARSIA Verify Token Request
verify-token-request.description: Request body for POST /v1/arsia/verify-token. The infrastructure router calls this endpoint to verify an external agent's token. Per ARSIA-Identity.md §7.7.

token.description: The JWT access token to be verified. Per ARSIA-Identity.md §7.7.
